title: unisema cordata
intro: Unisema cordata, commonly known as the Australian finger lime, is a small, native Australian tree in the citrus family. It is valued for its unique, cylindrical fruit which is rich in citric acid and has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to aid in digestion, lower blood pressure, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Unisema cordata include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which have been attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, limonoids, and ascorbic acid. The bioactive constituents of Unisema cordata have been shown to have potential health benefits, including anti-cancer and anti-aging properties, although further research is needed to confirm these findings.
